title: Reason Behind Improperly Sterilised Equipment at Tan Tock Seng's Dental Clinic and Preventive Measures Put in Place
what_it_is: Reason Behind Improperly Sterilised Equipment at Tan Tock Seng's Dental Clinic and Preventive Measures Put in Place

sections.label: Dental instruments sterilisation lapse
sections.summary: The Minister for Health answers questions on improperly sterilised dental instruments at Tan Tock Seng Hospital's dental clinic, apologising for the incident.

sentences.text: The following question stood in the name of Miss Cheng Li Hui – 15 To ask the Minister for Health (a) what is the reason why eight packs of dental instruments at Tan Tock Seng's dental clinic were not being thoroughly sterilised; (b) what measures are currently in place to ensure the proper sterilisation of dental instruments and whether they are sufficient; (c) whether there is a need to strengthen staff compliance with the sterilisation process in licensed healthcare institutions that house central sterile supply departments; and (d) how often are audits conducted in such institutions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health with regard to recent incidents of improperly sterilised equipment at dental clinics (a) what measures are currently in place to ensure the proper sterilisation of dental instruments in public and private clinics; (b) what training is being done to ensure staff compliance with the sterilisation process in licensed healthcare institutions; and (c) how often are audits or checks conducted in such institutions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Patient safety is of utmost importance to our healthcare institutions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We are disappointed with the lapse at the Tan Tock Seng Hospital's (TTSH's) Dental Clinic, which had led to the use of eight packs of dental instruments that had not undergone the final step of sterilisation, and we apologise for the incident.

sections.label: NHG investigation review report
sections.summary: The National Healthcare Group investigated the incident and the Ministry received its review report on 8 January 2019.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The National Healthcare Group (NHG) has conducted an investigation and the Ministry has received its review report on 8 January 2019.

sections.label: Disciplinary actions and strengthened systems
sections.summary: Counselling and disciplinary actions were recommended for 18 management and staff, and institutions were told to strengthen sterilisation systems, training and audits.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Counselling and disciplinary actions were recommended for 18 management and staff involved in the incident.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Immediately after the incident, the Ministry has also instructed all public and private healthcare institutions to further strengthen their systems and ensure staff awareness and strict adherence to all processes for patient safety and care.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: These include reminding healthcare institutions to: (a) heighten vigilance throughout the sterilisation process and check that instruments used are properly sterilised before being used; (b) step up on competency trainings for all staff; and (c) ensure periodic internal quality audits are conducted on the sterilisation process, as well as the delivery of sterilised instruments to the users.

sections.label: Ministry review of NHG findings
sections.summary: The Ministry will review the NHG report findings, consult experts, and consider further actions to reduce re-occurrence risks across the healthcare sector.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The Ministry will review the findings of the NHG review report, consult relevant domain and technical experts, and consider further actions to be taken to reduce the risks of a re-occurrence across the healthcare sector.

sections.label: Ministry's own investigation
sections.summary: The Ministry is conducting its own investigation and will consider whether further regulatory actions are necessary.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The Ministry is also conducting its own investigation and will consider if further regulatory actions are necessary.
